spirit:component.spirit:name: PDILoader
spirit:component.spirit:description: Loads a PDI from DDR at runtime through the PLM (IPI handshake over S_AXI_LPD); requests arrive on a PDILoad slave interface

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: IPI_CHANNEL
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: IPI channel 0..5 the requests are sent on (5 is also used by xsdb)

spirit:parameter.spirit:name: TIMEOUT_CYCLES
spirit:parameter.spirit:description: Clock cycles to wait for the PLM before reporting error 3
